args.message:
Upgrade fastjson from 2.8.0 to 2.9.4 to fix CVE-2026-31337

fastjson < 2.9.4 is affected by CVE-2026-31337 (high severity:
unbounded recursion when parsing deeply nested arrays). Bump to the
nearest fixed release on the same major version line.

args.body:
## Summary
- Upgrades fastjson from 2.8.0 to 2.9.4 in requirements.txt.

## Why
2.8.0 is affected by **CVE-2026-31337** (high severity): unbounded recursion when parsing deeply nested arrays. Affected versions are < 2.9.4 (and 3.0.0 up to but not including 3.1.0 on the 3.x line). 2.9.4 is the nearest fixed release on the current major version line, keeping the upgrade minimal.

## Validation
- CI run `ci-0001` on commit c8b8ab7878: **passed**.
